caption: The drawing shows a round plate or shallow bowl with a wide, flat rim depicted in grayscale pencil shading. At the top of the plate is an ornate, openwork handle with a symmetrical design featuring scrolls and a cross at the center top, as well as a heart shape below the cross. The handle has the text "DYER", "I * C", and possibly another small mark or symbol inscribed within its decorative elements. The bowl is shaded to create a sense of depth, with the darkest shading around the inner edge and lighter shading toward the center and edge. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a small rectangular inset that shows a side view of the plate or bowl, highlighting its profile and the attachment of the handle. The drawing is centered on an off-white or slightly yellowed background, and there are hand-drawn lines for the borders of the composition. In the lower left corner, a signature or notation can be seen: "E. Layton Drawn".
title: Silver Porringer
